name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Q
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement the 3-qubit bit-flip code in Qiskit with dynamic circuits: encode RY(2.109)|0>, apply an X error on qubit 0, extract the syndrome with two ancillas, correct with if_test, and verify the decoded statistics over 4096 shots. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
